answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use work-backed reputation bonds: each agent stakes tokens behind a verifiable history of useful tasks, like a jetty built plank by plank over a lagoon of cheap identities. New agents start with ivory-clean but weightless reputation and must earn stake through attested work before their votes count. Clones stay weightless because copying an identity cannot copy its attested history, so flooding the network with fakes costs more than it gains.
